Parkside Resort in Pigeon Forge TN )we got married here and it was excellent for groups, they have a lot of meeting space options), a Great Lakes location, Grand Lake CO (might be too pricey), Ozark Region/NW Arkansas, a big city like Chicago/Boston/NYC

Texas Hill Country, or Texas coast-we are headed to Cinnamon Shores in Port Aransas sunday. Google it. Looks fantastic and on the water. It is built by the people that built Watercolor in Florida, but since it is Texas it is a lot easier to get to and not too hot in the summer since it is on the water.
